hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" =~ \.(c|h)$ ]]; then echo '✓ 编译验证: '$f; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && cmake --build build/Debug 2>&1 | tail -20 || echo '⚠ 编译失败，请检查'; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

echo '🔧 STM32 F407 嵌入式项目环境检查'; which arm-none-eabi-gcc > /dev/null && echo '✓ ARM 工具链已安装' || echo '⚠ ARM 工具链未找到'; which cmake > /dev/null && echo '✓ CMake 已安装' || echo '⚠ CMake 未找到'; which openocd > /dev/null && echo '✓ OpenOCD 已安装' || echo '⚠ OpenOCD 未找到'; [ -d build/Debug ] && echo '✓ 构建目录存在' || echo 'ℹ 请运行: cmake --preset Debug'
